name: Cam Bank
desc: An engineering plate of a camshaft and follower bank — a row of profiled lobes (eccentric, double-dwell, snail, heart) turning on one shaft lifts its roller follower, valve stem and coil spring by exactly the cam's radius at contact, each station phased differently so the gallery ripples, while a live valve-lift-versus-angle oscillogram traces every profile along the bottom.

energy.doc: shaft speed + glow + line weight + plate drift

scale.doc: cam size and bank span — 2.2 fills the frame

hue.doc: plate tint (film/xray/schematic); other styles are fixed inks

anno.doc: centreline, station callouts, lift oscillogram, title block

style.doc: aesthetic: toned drafting film / prussian blueprint / aged brass / translucent additive x-ray / abstracted outline schematic

alpha.doc: ink opacity over the plate ground
